text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Roads department owes contractors Lm9 million ($26 million), Public Works Minister says. Debt will affect the department's budgeting in the short term.

- Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi disappointed that the new Maltese government was not seeking EU membership. UK Foreign Secretary Malcom Rifkind said a relationship beneficial for both the EU and Malta had to be developed.
- Finance minister insists VAT has to be collected until the law is removed.
- General Workers' Union urges health minister to insist that doctors stop pronouncing workers fit when they are unwell.
- Foreign Minister George Vella says Britain, Austria and Sweden see Malta's call for closer EU relations but not membership as a possible model for relations with other countries as well.
